params.linkText: closed on the sale of an industrial portfolio

children: to an affiliate of EQT Real Estate for ~$1.2B, the company said Thursday. The transaction is part of the REIT's previously announced portfolio realignment, a $2.0B disposition initiative of non-core assets to enhance Rexford's portfolio quality, cash flow durability, and balance sheet strength.

The portfolio sale included 22 industrial properties totaling 5.2M rentable square feet, averaging 237000 square feet per property. At closing, the portfolio had a weighted average remaining lease term of 2.7 years and in-place rents 28% above market rates.

"With $1.5B of dispositions completed year to date, we have made significant progress in strengthening our portfolio, improving the growth and resilience of our cash flow, and further enhancing our balance sheet," said CEO Laura Clark. The company has guided for 2026 dispositions of $1.5B-$2.0B.

has deployed a portion of disposition proceeds to repay $485M of debt and repurchase $205M of common stock. Year to date, the company has repaid $492M of debt and repurchased $505M of common stock. The remaining disposition proceeds are expected to go toward 2027 debt maturities, opportunistic repurchases of common stock under its $1.0B share repurchase program, and internal repositioning and development projects. The company's estimated year-end 2026 net debt to adjusted EBITDA is 3.5x.
As part of the announcement, the REIT reaffirmed its 2026 guidance provided in Q2 2026 earnings.

title: Rexford Industrial completes $1.2B portfolio sale to EQT Real Estate
